company.shortDescription: ALLO is a financial technology and blockchain infrastructure platform.
company.description: Allo is a financial technology and blockchain infrastructure platform that develops tools for tokenizing and managing real-world assets (RWAs) on-chain. The company provides systems for converting traditional financial assets such as stocks, funds, private equity, debt instruments, and other investment products into blockchain-based digital tokens. Its services include token issuance, fund administration, asset trading, lending, and settlement infrastructure.
